name: SENQ Aoyama
card: One minute from Aoyama-itchome Station, themed CREATOR'S VILLAGE
title: SENQ Aoyama — a “CREATOR'S VILLAGE” of 22 rooms on the 2nd floor of Lattice Aoyama Square
lead: SENQ Aoyama is on the 2nd floor of Lattice Aoyama Square, a one-minute walk from exit 4 of Aoyama-itchome Station. Its theme is “CREATOR'S VILLAGE”. It has 22 rooms from 7.39 m² to 33.74 m², a lounge, an open space and three meeting rooms, and it accepts room members only. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 22 rooms (7.39–33.74 m²) / lounge / open space / 3 meeting rooms
concept: CREATOR'S VILLAGE
SENQ Aoyama's theme is “CREATOR'S VILLAGE” — a village of creators in Aoyama.
With 22 rooms and recruitment of room members only, it works like a village where room holders share the lounge and open space.
steps: The lounge and open space are shared by the room members.
You can move between time shut away in your room and time meeting people in the shared areas.
There are 22 rooms ranging from 7.39 m² to 33.74 m², from ¥183,920 a month with utilities included in the rent.
Choose anything from a room for one to a room for a small team.
Reception is open 9:00–18:00 on weekdays. It is a one-minute walk from exit 4 of Aoyama-itchome Station.

word.title: What is room membership?
body: A membership where you rent a private room. SENQ Aoyama accepts room members only.
With no seat-only members, the shared spaces are used only by people with rooms — so the faces stay familiar, like a village.

name: SENQ Meguro
card: “Work while you live” — an 8th floor as relaxed as home
title: SENQ Meguro — a home-like workplace built around “working while living”, on the 8th floor of Meguro Center Building
lead: SENQ Meguro is on the 8th floor of the Meguro Center Building. Built around the concept of “working while living”, its appeal is a relaxed, home-like atmosphere, the website says. It has a lounge, a café area, 13 rooms, 26 solo booths, a meeting room and meeting booths. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Lounge / café area / 13 rooms (5.40–19.45 m²) / 26 solo booths / 1 meeting room (10) / 3 meeting booths (4)
concept: Working while living
SENQ Meguro's concept is “working while living”, and its appeal is a home-like, relaxed atmosphere, the website says.
On the 8th floor of the Meguro Center Building are a lounge and café area, private rooms and solo booths — a base where relaxation and focus share one floor.
steps: Shared spaces as relaxed as home
The lounge and café area are shared spaces with a home-like, relaxed feel.
Coworking is ¥22,000 a month, available 9:00–22:00 on weekdays.
There are 26 solo booths from ¥95,700 a month and 13 rooms from 5.40 m² to 19.45 m², from ¥165,000 a month. Rooms are available 24 hours.
From a seat to shut yourself away in to a room for a small team, it is all on one floor.
A room for ten and booths for four
There is one meeting room for ten and three meeting booths for four.
Short meetings in the booths, longer ones in the meeting room.

word.title: What is a solo booth?
body: A small, partitioned seat for one person. SENQ Meguro has 26 of them.
A relaxed lounge and solo booths to retreat into: having both creates the rhythm of “working while living”.

name: WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown Yaesu
card: 7th floor of Yaesu Central Tower, connected underground to Tokyo Station
title: WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown Yaesu — a shared office on the 7th floor of Yaesu Central Tower, directly connected to Tokyo Station
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown Yaesu is on the 7th floor of Yaesu Central Tower at Tokyo Midtown Yaesu. It connects underground to Tokyo Station (JR lines and the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line) and is open 10:00–18:00 on weekends and holidays too. It has an entrance lounge, an open space, meeting rooms for up to 12, private rooms and rental offices. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Weekdays 8:00–21:00 / weekends and holidays 10:00–18:00 (some private rooms and meeting rooms 5:30–23:30; Wednesdays 8:00–21:00)
Open space / meeting rooms (up to 12) / private rooms / rental offices
hero_cap: A workspace directly connected to the Yaesu exit of Tokyo Station
concept: Connected underground to Tokyo Station
WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown Yaesu connects underground to Tokyo Station on the JR lines and the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line. Step off the shinkansen and walk straight to your seat.
The website highlights security cameras and a sound-masking system to stop conversations carrying. Some private rooms and meeting rooms are available from 5:30 to 23:30 (8:00–21:00 on Wednesdays).
steps: Reception crew greet you at the 7th-floor entrance.
The open space needs no booking. There is a drinks corner, and chargers and stationery to borrow.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
Visitors arriving at Tokyo Station can be guided here underground.
Rooms you can use early and late
Private rooms are for calls and online meetings; some are available from 5:30 to 23:30.
Rental offices can be taken as a team base.

word.title: What is sound masking?
body: A system that plays an unobtrusive sound, similar to air-conditioning noise, into a space so conversations are harder to make out.
WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown Yaesu lists it as one of its measures against sound leaking.

credits: WORK STYLING official website: “Tokyo Midtown Yaesu”

name: WORK STYLING Otemachi
card: A white space with meeting rooms inspired by artworks from around the world
title: WORK STYLING Otemachi — a shared office with meeting rooms inspired by works of art, on the 6th floor of Otemachi One Tower
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Otemachi is on the 6th floor of Otemachi One Tower, directly connected to Otemachi Station. It is a modern, refined space in white, and its meeting rooms take artworks from around the world as their motifs. Besides meeting rooms for up to 12, there are rooms for 13–80 people. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Modern white space / meeting rooms inspired by artworks from around the world
Single-person rooms / meeting rooms (up to 12 and 13–80) / open space / rental offices
concept: Meeting rooms inspired by works of art
WORK STYLING Otemachi is a modern, refined space based on white. Its meeting rooms have interiors that take artworks from around the world as motifs, the website says.
It is on the 6th floor of Otemachi One Tower, directly connected to Otemachi Station, reachable on foot from the Toei Mita Line and the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda, Marunouchi, Tozai and Hanzomon lines.
steps: From the entrance, a space based on white unfolds.
The open space can be used without booking.
A different artwork motif in every room
The meeting rooms for up to 12 have interiors inspired by artworks from around the world.
Rooms for 13–80 people are also available for large meetings and briefings.
Rental offices can be taken as a team base.
Directly connected to Otemachi Station, they make it easy to come and go with clients.

word.title: What is a motif?
body: The subject a design is based on. WORK STYLING Otemachi uses artworks from around the world as motifs for its meeting rooms.
Rooms of the same size become easier to remember and tell apart when each has its own subject.

name: WORK STYLING Yaesu North Exit
card: 17th floor of GranTokyo North Tower, directly connected to Tokyo Station
title: WORK STYLING Yaesu North Exit — a shared office on the 17th floor of GranTokyo North Tower, directly connected to Tokyo Station
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Yaesu North Exit is on the 17th floor of GranTokyo North Tower, on the Yaesu North side of Tokyo Station. Directly connected to Tokyo Station (JR lines and the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line), it has an open space, meeting rooms for up to 12 and single-person rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Single-person rooms / meeting rooms (up to 12) / open space
Directly connected to Tokyo Station (JR lines, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line)
concept: Seventeen floors above Tokyo Station
WORK STYLING Yaesu North Exit is on the 17th floor of GranTokyo North Tower, directly connected to Tokyo Station. From the ticket gates to a high-floor seat without going outside.

It is a seven-minute walk from Nihombashi Station (Ginza and Tozai lines) and ten from Kyobashi Station (Ginza Line). The layout is focused: meeting rooms, single-person rooms and an open space you can use without booking.
steps: Seats you can take without booking
The open space can be used without booking.
There is a drinks corner, and chargers and stationery to borrow.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
Welcome visitors arriving at Tokyo Station in a building connected to the station.
Single-person rooms are for calls and online meetings.
Separate phone booths are also available.

word.title: What does “directly connected to the station” mean?
body: You can enter the building from the station's gates or underground passages without going outside.
WORK STYLING Yaesu North Exit is directly connected to Tokyo Station on the JR lines and the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line — a big plus on rainy days and on business trips with luggage.

credits: WORK STYLING official website: “Yaesu North Exit”

name: WORK STYLING Yaesu South Exit
card: Open 8:00–22:00 on weekends too, on the 2nd floor of Pacific Century Place Marunouchi
title: WORK STYLING Yaesu South Exit — a shared office open at weekends, on the 2nd floor of Pacific Century Place Marunouchi
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Yaesu South Exit is on the 2nd floor of Pacific Century Place Marunouchi, near the Yaesu South exit of Tokyo Station. It is open from 8:00 to 22:00 on weekdays and weekends alike, with an open space, meeting rooms for up to 12 and private rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Open space / meeting rooms (up to 12) / private rooms
3 min from JR Tokyo Sta. / 2 min from the JR Keiyo Line / 3 min from Kyobashi Sta. (Ginza Line)
concept: Open late, even at weekends
WORK STYLING Yaesu South Exit is open 8:00–22:00 on weekdays and weekends. The website highlights weekend and holiday opening as a feature of the site.

It is on the 2nd floor of Pacific Century Place Marunouchi, three minutes' walk from JR Tokyo Station and two from the Keiyo Line platforms. With many photos of its open space, it is a site built around shared seating.
steps: Reception crew greet you at the 2nd-floor entrance.
It is just a short walk from the Yaesu South side of Tokyo Station.
Seats you can take without booking
The open space can be used without booking.
There is a drinks corner, and chargers and stationery to borrow.
Rooms for up to 12, and rooms for one
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
Private rooms can be used in 10-minute units, ideal for calls and online meetings.

word.title: What is pay-as-you-go?
body: Paying only for the time you use. At WORK STYLING this is the SHARE plan; at Yaesu South Exit it starts at ¥340 per 10 minutes.
No monthly contract — ideal when you only need a few hours on a business trip or at the weekend.

credits: WORK STYLING official website: “Yaesu South Exit”

name: WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower
card: “WORKSTYLING LAB” — nine meeting rooms, each with a different theme
title: WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower — the “WORKSTYLING LAB” with nine themed meeting rooms, directly connected to Mitsukoshimae Station
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower is on the 6th floor of Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower, directly connected to Mitsukoshimae Station on the Tokyo Metro Ginza and Hanzomon lines. Its concept is “WORKSTYLING LAB”, with nine meeting rooms, each with a different theme. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: WORKSTYLING LAB (nine meeting rooms with different themes)
Open space / meeting rooms (up to 12 and 13–80) / private rooms / rental offices
concept: WORKSTYLING LAB
The concept of WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower is “WORKSTYLING LAB”. With nine meeting rooms, each with its own theme, it responds to the many ways people work today, the website says.
It is directly connected to Mitsukoshimae Station and to Shin-Nihombashi Station on the JR Sobu Line, and is an eight-minute walk from JR Kanda and Tokyo stations.
steps: Reception crew greet you at the 6th-floor entrance.
The open space has many kinds of seating, so you can choose where to sit according to the day's work.
Each meeting room has a different theme. Besides rooms for up to 12, there are rooms for 13–80 people.
Choose a room to suit the meeting — or your mood.

word.title: What is WORKSTYLING LAB?
body: The concept of WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower. As the word “lab” suggests, it has nine meeting rooms, each with a different theme.
Different meetings suit different rooms. Giving each room its own character makes this a place to try out many ways of working.

credits: WORK STYLING official website: “Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower”

name: WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Takashimaya Mitsui Building
card: 9th floor of the Nihonbashi Takashimaya Mitsui Building, directly connected to Nihombashi Station
title: WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Takashimaya Mitsui Building — a shared office and private rooms on the 9th floor, directly connected to Nihombashi Station
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Takashimaya Mitsui Building is on the 9th floor of the Nihonbashi Takashimaya Mitsui Building, directly connected to Nihombashi Station on the Tokyo Metro Ginza and Tozai lines and the Toei Asakusa Line. It has an open space, meeting rooms for up to 12 and single-person rooms, and supports company registration. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Takashimaya Mitsui Building
Single-person rooms / meeting rooms (up to 12) / open space
Directly connected to Nihombashi Sta. (Ginza, Tozai, Toei Asakusa lines) / 5 min from JR Tokyo Sta.
concept: Nine floors above Nihombashi Station
WORK STYLING Nihonbashi Takashimaya Mitsui Building is on the 9th floor of a building directly connected to Nihombashi Station on three lines, and a five-minute walk from JR Tokyo Station.
The website highlights its direct station access and the option to register a company here. Companies on a dedicated-space plan can register this as their head-office address.
steps: Seats you can take without booking
The open space can be used without booking.
There is a drinks corner, and chargers and stationery to borrow.
Meeting rooms hold up to 12 people.
Directly connected to Nihombashi Station, it is easy to direct visitors here.
Single-person rooms are for calls and online meetings.
Separate phone booths are also available.

word.title: What is company registration?
body: Registering details such as the location of a company's head office with the Legal Affairs Bureau. Some shared offices allow it, some do not.
At WORK STYLING, companies on the dedicated-space plan (FLEX) or the single-site unlimited plan (BASE) can register.
